audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers disagreed. Content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both read Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Akali/Akali, while the full layer read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Akali/Skill/Skill — including a live contradiction at Level 6, where phases[4].side said Akali and win[4] said Neeko.
audit.why: Akali's Five Point Strike costs 110 mana at rank 1 and her whole rotation is mana-gated pre-item, so Neeko owns levels 1-5 on the 1000-range E into Q. Level 6 stays Neeko's because Pop Blossom's preparation is hidden while disguised and Perfect Execution only reaches 675, so she has to enter the 600-range knockup to kill you. The lane flips on her first item, when the mana pool arrives.
audit.corrected: phases[0..4].side = Neeko, phases[5..6].side = Akali, with every why rewritten to match and ratings moved with them.
sources: ownerKit R range 600 and hidden preparation

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes said 'level 6 adds the ambush; Luden's makes the package lethal' — it gives Neeko the first-item spike that the chart and the content layer both hand to Akali.
audit.why: Akali's first item is the spike in this lane because it fixes the only thing holding her back — mana for a 1.5s-recycling Q. Neeko's Luden's does not change who wins the fight, it just makes her level 3 pattern hurt more.
audit.corrected: Level 3 root-bloom is the kill pattern; level 6 answers her dive; her first item takes the lane back.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all — the catalogue's defect 3. Not one real number appeared anywhere on the page: not Twilight Shroud's 20s, not Q's 1.5s recycle, not Shuriken Flip's 16s/825 range, not the 120/90/60 on Perfect Execution.
audit.why: Every timing decision in this matchup is a comparison of two numbers: Neeko's E at 12s against Shuriken Flip at 16s, and Neeko's R at 120/105/90 against Perfect Execution at 120/90/60 — which recycles almost twice as fast as hers by rank 3. Without the numbers the advice is unactionable.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries Twilight Shroud 20s at rank 1, Five Point Strike 1.5s at 110 mana, and Perfect Execution 120/90/60 against Neeko's 120/105/90.

audit.whatIsWrong: Perfect Execution's execute threshold was never stated, and the page instead told the reader to 'greed blooms at half HP' with a body that talked about something else entirely.
audit.why: Riot's text: the re-cast executes all enemies she strikes. Chasing a last bloom at low HP is the exact state that ability is built to punish, and the recast is on 60s at rank 3.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d now states the execute threshold and the 60s rank-3 cooldown; enemyWin restates it as her win condition.
sources: enemyKit R text and execute flag

audit.whatIsWrong: Assassin's Mark — the auto-attack reset that opens her combo — is not mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: The ring appears when she lands spell damage; leaving it empowers her next attack. The tell is the ring, not the ability cast, so the step-back cue is earlier than the page implies.
audit.corrected: Not written. No existing field could carry it inside its length band without dropping a number that is doing more work. Recorded here and in notes.
sources: enemyKit P text and autoReset flag

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t ended 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain.' Akali has no heal or lifesteal anywhere in her kit.
audit.why: Grievous Wounds does nothing here. The item advice that does matter is when the Zhonya's lands relative to her ultimate.
audit.corrected: Replaced with 'Buy the Zhonya's before her R spike, not after.'
sources: enemyKit — no heal flag on any slot

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed on four bullets: dosFull[0].d (title 'Hold E strictly for her engage') carried the Shroud line; dosFull[1].d (title 'Disguise in the wave when she hits 6') carried tradeGood; dontsFull[1].d (title 'Shove past river without the root banked') carried the clone paragraph; dontsFull[2].d (title 'Greed blooms at half HP') carried tradeBad verbatim.
audit.why: Defect 2 — the title promises one thing and the body explains another.
audit.corrected: All four bodies rewritten to answer their own titles from Akali's kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Akali was addressed as he/his/him across the entire full layer — tldr, winCon, tradeGood, ahead, breakdown.early, breakdown.wave, dosFull[0].t, dosFull[1].t, dontsFull[0].t, report[0].t, report[1].t, report[3].t, report[4].t, report[8].t, report[9].t, report[11].t, report[13].t — while the content layer had her correctly as she/her.
audit.why: champ-gender lists akali as female. The full layer was written from a male-enemy template with only the name swapped.

Riot's Twilight Shroud text says she is 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks', which is a targeting statement. Whether a Neeko E skillshot still roots her while she is inside the smoke is not answerable from the kit file, and the answer changes the whole matchup.
audit.corrected: Left unasserted in both directions — the page now says she is unselectable inside and to hold CC for the exit, which is true either way.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood claimed 'the full package is half a bar at level 3' — a magnitude with no source (defect 6), and phases[2].why repeated it.
audit.why: No damage figures exist in the kits. The sequence is real; the fraction is invented.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the sequence and its ranges: E at 1000, Q so the seed blooms again, auto for the passive, leave before Shroud drops.

notes: packet.defects flagged 'Her Perfect Execution' in spikes[1].text as a probable wrong ability name — it is a FALSE POSITIVE. Perfect Execution is the correct name of Akali's R per the kit file; the possessive pronoun in front of it tripped the near-miss check. No edit made there. Full layer was written from a male-enemy template throughout while the content layer had Akali correctly female — 17 fields corrected. Level chart: phases[4].side said Akali while win[4] said Neeko, a live two-answer row on the page; the whole chart is proposed as one atomic group. report[8].t told the reader to buy anti-heal 'into his sustain' — Akali has no heal in her kit at all, so that was a fabricated interaction and is replaced. Assassin's Mark (the auto-reset burst tell) is still missing from the page: no field could carry it inside its band without dropping a cooldown that earns its space more. Fields left templated and ungrounded: breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding, loading, tradeBad. No elo tiers written.
